constraints: PHP grammar uses base_clause and class_interface_clause as child nodes, not field names, requiring traversal rather than field lookup
DEFUSE_QUERY is required for semantic analysis (def-use tracking); all languages with methods/functions should implement it
Tree-sitter-php grammar distinguishes function_definition (top-level) from method_declaration (class/interface/trait members)
PHP interfaces, traits, and enums are distinct node types (interface_declaration, trait_declaration, enum_declaration) each with name field and body

Inheritance in PHP: class_declaration uses base_clause (extends) and class_interface_clause (implements) as optional child nodes, not fields; enum_declaration also uses class_interface_clause for interface implementation
test_coverage: Existing language modules test: (1) ELEMENT_QUERY extraction of all declaration kinds (functions, methods, classes, interfaces, etc.), (2) extract_inheritance for extends/implements, (3) DEFUSE_QUERY write/read sites, (4) extract_function_name correctness, (5) find_receiver_type and find_method_for_receiver for OO languages, (6) edge cases (empty files, no inheritance, nested declarations). Java and Python modules have 5-8 test functions each covering these dimensions.

approaches.name: Minimal PHP integration (CSS-like template)
approaches.description: Add php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY covering function_definition, method_declaration, class_declaration, interface_declaration, trait_declaration, enum_declaration; CALL_QUERY for method_invocation; IMPORT_QUERY for namespace_use_declaration; no DEFUSE_QUERY, no inheritance handler. Register in mod.rs get_language_info() and get_ts_language(), add .php extension to EXTENSION_MAP, add tree-sitter-php dependency.

approaches.name: Full PHP integration with DEFUSE_QUERY and inheritance
approaches.description: Add php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY covering local variable declarations, assignments, and identifier reads; implement extract_inheritance() handler to walk base_clause and class_interface_clause child nodes; register in mod.rs (both functions), add .php extension, add tree-sitter-php dependency, add comprehensive tests (element extraction, inheritance, defuse sites, edge cases).
pros: Enables advanced code analysis (call graph, type inference)
cons: More code (~200-250 lines for php.rs + tests)
Requires understanding of PHP grammar structure
More complex inheritance walk (child node traversal vs field lookup)

approaches.name: Phased integration: element extraction first, then defuse/inheritance
approaches.description: Phase 1: Add php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY and CALL_QUERY only; register in mod.rs and lang.rs; add .php extension. Phase 2 (follow-up PR): Add DEFUSE_QUERY, extract_inheritance, REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY; add tests. Allows incremental review and validation.
pros: Allows community feedback on Phase 1 before Phase 2
Reduces risk of single large change
cons: Requires two PRs and two reviews

recommendation: Approach 2 (Full PHP integration with DEFUSE_QUERY and inheritance). Rationale: The issue explicitly requests PHP support; the codebase already has Java, Python, Rust, and other languages with full semantic analysis (defuse_query + inheritance). A minimal integration would be inconsistent with project standards and would require a follow-up PR to reach feature parity. The full approach is medium complexity (not high), and the tree-sitter-php grammar is well-documented. Implementing DEFUSE_QUERY is essential because it enables def-use tracking, which is a core feature of the analyzer (used by SemanticExtractor and DefUseSite analysis). The inheritance walk is straightforward once the base_clause/class_interface_clause structure is understood from the grammar.
language_info_struct_citation:
pub struct LanguageInfo {
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub language: Language,
    pub element_query: &'static str,
    pub call_query: &'static str,
    pub reference_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub import_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_trait_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub defuse_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub extract_function_name: Option<ExtractFunctionNameHandler>,
    pub find_method_for_receiver: Option<FindMethodForReceiverHandler>,
    pub find_receiver_type: Option<FindReceiverTypeHandler>,
    pub extract_inheritance: Option<ExtractInheritanceHandler>,
}
element_query_draft:
pub const ELEMENT_QUERY: &str = r"
(function_definition
  name: (name) @func_name) @function
(method_declaration
  name: (name) @method_name) @function
(class_declaration
  name: (name) @class_name) @class
(interface_declaration
  name: (name) @interface_name) @class
(trait_declaration
  name: (name) @trait_name) @class
(enum_declaration
  name: (name) @enum_name) @class
";
defuse_query_draft:
pub const DEFUSE_QUERY: &str = r"
(assignment_expression left: (variable_name) @write.assign)
(variable_declarator name: (variable_name) @write.local)
(foreach_statement value: (variable_name) @write.foreach)
(catch_clause (variable_name) @write.catch)
(variable_name) @read.usage
";
inheritance_walk_citation: From tree-sitter-php grammar (github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter-php): class_declaration node has optional child nodes base_clause (for extends) and class_interface_clause (for implements), not field names. Walk: (1) get class_declaration node, (2) iterate child nodes, (3) for each base_clause child, iterate its named children to find name nodes (class parent names), (4) for each class_interface_clause child, iterate its named children to find name nodes (interface names). Each name node's text is extracted via source[node.start_byte()..node.end_byte()]. Same pattern applies to enum_declaration which also has optional class_interface_clause for interface implementation.
